name: Tessera
description: Self-hosted file and note sharing that cleans up after itself

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database, every uploaded file (blobs/), the log copy for the admin panel and secret.key, the key that seals the passwords saved in the admin panel. Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Tessera web app, admin panel and API, published on host as 6178

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: TESSERA_AUTH__ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional. The password for the first admin account (user name admin). Leave it empty and Tessera makes one on first start and prints it in the app log once. Only used on the very first start.
